metadata.title: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A - Information security controls (titles)
metadata.remarks: The 93 controls of ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A (identical to ISO/IEC 27002:2022), grouped by the four themes. Only control numbers and titles are listed; the control text and guidance are protected by copyright of ISO and are not part of this catalog. ISO/IEC 27001 is available from ISO (https://www.iso.org/standard/27001) and, in Germany, as DIN EN ISO/IEC 27001 from DIN Media.
